saga: Y1 Steward Bertram the Gray: “The granary counts 40 measures — a season, no more. Plant a farm on open plains.”
Y1 Steward Bertram the Gray: “Every wall and roof to come is standing in that forest. A lumber camp — near the trees, while they last.”
Y1 The raiders have set up camp in the wilds — Adder's Nest. For now, it is only a nest of brigands.
Y2 Steward Bertram the Gray: “When they mass at the tents, you have time yet. When the camp stirs — you do not.”
Y2 Steward Bertram the Gray: “The ground there is spent, and the camp struck itself — the timbers are already home. The land lies open for the plough now. Follow the forest.”
Y2 The war-camp stirs — Adder's Nest may march soon.
Y3 Steward Bertram the Gray: “You have swords enough to answer the warlord at the tents, sire — if you dare leave home thin.”
Y3 The host marches on Adder's Nest — 14 swords. The kingdom stands thinner behind them.
Y4 The host falls upon Adder's Nest! Battle is joined at the tents.
Y4 The camp is stripped bare — arm-rings and weapons off the dead: 25 gold, 20 goods.
Y4 One slips through the reeds — Ebba, a midwife. Remember the name: Ebba.
Y4 Adder's Nest is no more. 8 souls. The Chronicle will keep their names even if you will not.
Y4 14 of your soldiers come home marked by the burning. Nothing frightens them now — and they will never lay down the sword.
Y4 The host returns from the ashes of Adder's Nest. No songs are sung.
Y6 The axes fall silent at a lumber camp — the wood nearby is spent. The cleared land lies open.
Y6 The lumber camp at the spent ground is struck — its timbers come home.
Y7 Warlord Ebba the Ash-Sworn raises her banner at the Hanged Grove. She sends no riders. She wants no gold.
Y7 EBBA THE ASH-SWORN HAS COME. She remembers the burning. She will take no gold.
Y7 Steward Bertram the Gray: “Warlord Ebba the Ash-Sworn has claimed the nest. Her raids will march from there — you can watch that road now.”
